picker.placement: Home, directly below the top bar

interaction.selection_sync_test: At 390x844, setting rail scrollLeft to 146 selected Durak after the scroll debounce.
interaction.keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and Home/End selection are covered by in-app tests.

desktop_input_probe.method: Foreground CUA horizontal scroll right, amount 3, over the game tab list
desktop_input_probe.observed_after: Selected · Blackjack; tab bounds unchanged from the fresh pre-input capture
desktop_input_probe.result: No visible rail movement; this did not verify a physical touch swipe.

picker.touch_test_limit: Native overflow/scroll-snap and selection synchronization were checked; the foreground CUA probe produced no visible movement, and an earlier CDP touch injection timed out. Physical iOS/Safari swiping remains unverified.

spin.behavior: Horizontal slot-style roll that decelerates to a random selection; does not start a round or charge a wager.

visual_review: Built-in vision reviewed the 320x700, 390x844, and 1024x768 Home states, plus 390x844 mid-spin and settled-spin states. The selected game, controls, fade edges, and roll state were legible without horizontal page overflow.
